request.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the adult astronaut shown in <Picture 1>, with the same face, orange spacesuit and photographic surroundings.

summary:
A single realistic live-action shot of <Subject 1> speaking one short English sentence to the camera, using <Picture 1> as the visual identity and scene reference.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve facial identity, orange spacesuit and reference scene while animating natural speech and a gentle final smile.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] A locked static camera shows <Subject 1> in the same orange spacesuit and photographic scene. The on-screen adult woman with a clear, calm English speaking voice (S1) looks toward the camera and says once: <d>[English] Factory makes useful tools.</d> Her mouth movements naturally match these words. After the final word, her lips close and she stops speaking, holding a gentle smile through the end of the shot. No cuts.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet room ambience. No other voices or additional speech.

non_diegetic_music:
None.

expected.positive_text: a video frame of an astronaut in an orange spacesuit
negative_texts: a photograph of a blue car
a photograph of a black dog
a photograph of a green tree

astronaut_first.conversion: Full original recorded astronaut photograph resized to 384x256; no generated pixels.
